customManagers.description: Upstream Laya revision that CI checks out into .upstream

packageRules.description: Everything except upstream: detect and list on the Dependency Dashboard, open a PR only when ticked there
Upstream releases: one PR on a fixed branch, which upstream-port.yml hands to Claude Code
prBodyNotes: The **Upstream port** workflow ports this release with Claude Code and pushes the result to this branch. If every check passes it labels the PR `port-ready`, and **Upstream release** then merges it and publishes the new version once CI is green.
